scope: Jan Sunwais, marches, protests, rallies, conventions and press conferences about the revision, organised by civil-society groups, independent commissions, youth groups and political parties of every side. Events organised by a political party are marked. The Election Commission's and the Chief Electoral Officers' own camps are left out, and their dates are on the Rules page.

events.title: Jan Sunwai on a public audit of the roll in Mangolpuri
events.organiser: Jan Sarokar, Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan and Voter Adhikar Manch
events.place: Mangolpuri, New Delhi
events.quote: The findings were presented at a public hearing, or Jan Sunwai, held in Mangolpuri on September 5, 2026.
events.what: The findings of a door-to-door audit of Y Block were presented at a public hearing.

events.title: BJP press conference on the Election Commission and SIR row
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party (national spokesperson Sambit Patra)
events.place: BJP Central Office, New Delhi
events.quote: NEW DELHI: The BJP on Wednesday defended the election commission over the row surrounding an alleged split among the poll panel's commissioners, with party MP Sambit Patra saying that internal deliberations between the three election commissioners were a sign of a healthy democracy.
events.what: BJP MP Sambit Patra held a press conference at which he defended the Election Commission after reports that two Election Commissioners had objected to decisions on the electoral rolls. He said the correspondence among the three commissioners was a sign of a healthy democracy.

events.title: Rahul Gandhi press conference on the Election Commissioners' objections to SIR decisions
events.organiser: Indian National Congress (Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi)
events.place: Congress headquarters, New Delhi
events.quote: Leader of Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi addresses the media on CEC Gyanesh Kumar row at the Congress Headquarters in New Delhi on September 24, 2026.
events.what: Rahul Gandhi held a press conference after a news report that two of the three Election Commissioners had formally objected at least 14 times in 10 months to decisions on the electoral rolls. He demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

events.title: Congress nationwide protests demanding the CEC's resignation
events.organiser: Indian National Congress, with state units, the Delhi Congress and the Indian Youth Congress
events.place: Several states, including marches in Patna, Lucknow, Assam (towards the Chief Electoral Officer's office), Jammu, Imphal and Delhi (Delhi Congress office towards Nirvachan Sadan)
events.quote: The Congress on Friday (September 25, 2026) led nationwide protests demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, accusing him of compromising the integrity of India’s electoral process, with the party’s general secretary (organisation), K.C. Venugopal, seeking Mr. Kumar’s resignation and arrest for alleged electoral malpractice.
events.what: Congress workers held street protests in several states demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Police used water cannons in Patna, Lucknow and Punjab and detained protesters in Assam, Jammu, Odisha, Manipur, Delhi and other states.

events.title: Press conference of Voter Adhikar Manch
events.organiser: Voter Adhikar Manch
events.place: New Delhi
events.quote: Members of Voter Adhikar Manch addresses a press conference on SIR in New Delhi on September 28, 2026.
events.what: A press conference on the revision.

events.title: Jan Sunwai (public hearing) on wrongful SIR deletions in Bihar
events.organiser: CPI(ML) Liberation, Bihar State unit
events.place: Patna
events.quote: Communist Party of India (Marxist-Leninist) Liberation General Secretary Dipankar Bhattacharya on Thursday (October 1, 2026) slammed the Election Commission of India (ECI) over alleged illegalities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).
events.what: A public hearing in Patna where about 20 voters whose names were allegedly deleted gave testimony before a five-member jury. It was based on a voter verification survey the party ran in seven Bihar districts.

events.title: Protest at Shivaji Park
events.organiser: Cockroach Janta Party
events.place: Shivaji Park, Mumbai
events.quote: the group will hold a protest at Mumbai’s Shivaji Park, a no-sound or silence zone, on Friday (October 2, 2026)
events.what: A protest calling for the Chief Election Commissioner to resign. The police had not granted permission when it was announced.

events.title: 'Save Democracy' marches in all districts
events.organiser: INDIA bloc
events.place: District headquarters across India, ending in demonstrations before district magistrates' offices
events.quote: Under that “save democracy” marches will be taken out in all districts from October 2-8 and demonstrations will be held before the district magistrate’s office, the Congress President stated, adding that youth and NGOs would also be invited for the event.
events.what: The INDIA bloc announced 'save democracy' marches in every district from 2 to 8 October, ending in demonstrations outside district magistrates' offices. Reports show some were held, including a protest by INDIA bloc parties outside the Collectorate in Hyderabad on 6 October and a march by the RJD, Congress and Left in Patna on 7 October.

events.title: Virat Garjana Morcha (Grand Roar March)
events.organiser: Shiv Sena (UBT) and Maharashtra Navnirman Sena, with state leaders of the Congress and NCP (SP)
events.place: Metro Cinema to the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation headquarters, south Mumbai
events.quote: Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray and Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) boss Raj Thackeray on Sunday (October 4, 2026) led a protest march in Mumbai against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
events.what: A march in Mumbai led by Uddhav Thackeray and Raj Thackeray against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Participants demanded his removal or resignation over alleged irregularities in the SIR. Party flags were not allowed and marchers carried the national flag.

events.title: INDIA bloc MPs' march from Parliament to the Election Commission
events.organiser: INDIA bloc (Congress, Samajwadi Party, Trinamool Congress, CPI(M) and other parties), with BJD leaders
events.place: Parliament House towards Nirvachan Sadan, New Delhi
events.quote: The Delhi Police on Tuesday (October 6, 2026) detained around 260 people, including 10 Members of Parliament, during a protest march by the INDIA bloc from Parliament House towards the Election Commission of India (ECI) office.
events.what: Opposition MPs marched from Parliament House towards the Election Commission's headquarters. Police stopped the march at barricades and detained about 260 people, including 10 MPs. Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other Congress leaders were detained after they began a sit-in inside the Akashvani Bhawan premises.

events.title: Protest and people's tribunal at Freedom Park
events.organiser: Cockroach Janta Party
events.place: Freedom Park, Bengaluru
events.quote: The Bengaluru protest is scheduled for October 8 at 10:30 am at Freedom Park.
events.what: A protest against the revision with a people's tribunal.

events.title: Lok Bhavan March
events.organiser: INDIA bloc (Mahagathbandhan) in Bihar, led by RJD's Tejashwi Yadav, with the Congress, VIP, CPI, CPI(ML) Liberation and Indian Inclusive Party
events.place: From the Seven Martyrs statue in front of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha towards Lok Bhavan, Patna. Stopped at the third barricade
events.quote: The INDIA bloc (Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance) leaders, led by Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) National Working President Tejashwi Yadav, on Thursday (October 8, 2026) took out a massive Lok Bhavan March in Patna.
events.what: A march in Patna by INDIA bloc parties towards Lok Bhavan demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Police stopped it at the third barricade and detained several leaders. A delegation led by Tejashwi Yadav then gave the Governor of Bihar a memorandum addressed to the President.

events.title: Protest at Jantar Mantar
events.organiser: Cockroach Janta Party
events.place: Jantar Mantar, New Delhi
events.quote: has announced another protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar on October 10, 2026
events.what: A protest calling for the Chief Election Commissioner to resign. The disputes page carries the report of the day itself.

events.title: 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' block-level marches
events.organiser: Indian National Congress
events.place: Block level across India, ending at Sub Divisional Magistrates' offices
events.quote: From October 10 to 20, block-level marches will be held, culminating at Sub Divisional Magistrates offices under the ‘Vote bachao, Desh bachao’ umbrella.
events.what: The Congress announced block-level marches from 10 to 20 October, ending at Sub Divisional Magistrates' offices, as part of its 'Vote bachao, Desh bachao' campaign. The campaign also asks the party's booth agents to find voters deleted unfairly and help them re-enrol.

events.title: Left Front protests across West Bengal
events.organiser: Left Front and student organisations of the Left parties
events.place: Across West Bengal (places not specified)
events.quote: The Left Front and student organisations associated with the Left parties staged protests across the State on October 11, demanding the resignation of the CEC and the scrapping of SIR.
events.what: Protests across West Bengal by the Left Front and Left student organisations demanding the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation and the scrapping of the SIR.

events.title: March for Democracy
events.organiser: INDIA bloc (Congress, Samajwadi Party, RJD, Shiv Sena (UBT), Trinamool Congress, CPI(M), CPI(ML) Liberation, CPI and others), with the student bodies AISA, SFI and AISF
events.place: Constitution Club towards the Supreme Court, New Delhi, through central Delhi and back via Mandi House. Stopped by police near the Supreme Court
events.quote: Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi, with Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other leaders from the INDIA bloc during the march from Barakhamba to Supreme Court in New Delhi on October 12, 2026
events.what: A march through central Delhi from the Constitution Club towards the Supreme Court, where Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders filed a petition over alleged large-scale voter deletions and irregularities in the SIR. Police stopped the procession near the court. The Congress said 2.5 lakh people took part.

events.title: Procession against the CEC and SIR (stopped by police)
events.organiser: Trinamool Congress (the faction led by Mamata Banerjee), with Dola Sen, Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay and Kunal Ghosh
events.place: Rajabazar, Kolkata
events.quote: Leaders and supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress, who had gathered in Kolkata on Tuesday (October 13, 2026) to hold a procession in protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Special Intensive Revision (SIR), were not allowed to march as the police said that no permission was obtained for the event.
events.what: Leaders and supporters of the Trinamool Congress faction led by Mamata Banerjee gathered at Rajabazar in Kolkata for a procession against the Chief Election Commissioner and the SIR. Police did not allow them to march, saying no permission had been sought, and the crowd dispersed.

events.title: Lok Bhawan March by Left students' and youth wings
events.organiser: Students' and youth wings of Left parties, including AISA and RYA (CPI(ML) Liberation) and the CPI's student wing, with the Bheem Army
events.place: Gandhi Maidan towards Raj Bhavan (Lok Bhawan), Patna
events.quote: Young protesters and members of the students’ wings of Left parties, including the Communist Party of India-Marxist-Leninist (CPI-M-L), the Communist Party of India (CPI), the Revolutionary Youth Association (RYA), and the Bheem Army took out a protest march in Patna on Tuesday (October 13, 2026), seeking the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and re-elections in Bihar and West Bengal, where, they alleged “vote chori (theft) through the SIR (Special Intensive Revision)” had taken place.
events.what: Student and youth activists marched from Gandhi Maidan towards Raj Bhavan in Patna over the SIR. Police stopped them near Dak Bungalow roundabout and detained many.

events.title: BJP district rallies backing the SIR (statewide mass awareness campaign)
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party, Assam unit
events.place: District headquarters across Assam. Rallies were reported in Nalbari on 13 October, Guwahati and Jorhat on 14 October, and Silchar
events.quote: The mobilisation followed Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma’s announcement on Monday that the BJP would hold peaceful rallies at district headquarters across Assam from October 13 to 31.
events.what: A series of BJP rallies at district headquarters in Assam backing the Prime Minister and the SIR of electoral rolls. In Guwahati the state party chief Dilip Saikia led a 'Jana Jagaran Samadal' rally from Khanapara.

events.title: Public hearing of the Independent Commission on SIR
events.organiser: Independent Commission on the Special Intensive Revision, chaired by Justice Madan B. Lokur, proposed by the Lawyers' Association for Constitution
events.place: Jawahar Bhawan, Dr Rajendra Prasad Road, Windsor Place, New Delhi
events.quote: Date: Thursday, 15 October 2026
events.what: Voters gave testimony to a panel of retired judges. The release calls it the first of a series of hearings across the country. No later date had been announced by 22 October.

events.title: 'Stop Vote Chori' protest at Parliament Square
events.organiser: Indian Overseas Congress Youth wing, supported by Save Democracy, SFI U.K. and South Asia Solidarity Group
events.place: Mahatma Gandhi statue, Parliament Square, London
events.quote: Hundreds gathered at Mahatma Gandhi’s statue at Parliament Square in London on Saturday (October 17, 2026) for a protest organised by the Opposition Congress and UK-based Indian students’ groups against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
events.what: A protest in London against the Chief Election Commissioner and the SIR, with Dhruv Rathee as keynote speaker. A smaller group of government supporters held a counter-protest nearby.

events.title: Jan Sunwai on a public audit of the roll in Okhla
events.organiser: Jan Sarokar, Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan, Voter Adhikar Manch and the National Federation of Indian Women
events.place: Batla House area, Jamia Nagar, Okhla, New Delhi
events.quote: held in the Batla House area of the national capital on Sunday (October 18, 2026)
events.what: A public hearing on a door-to-door audit of the roll in two polling booths. More than 150 voters registered to put their cases to a panel of advocates and activists.

events.title: Uttar Pradesh Congress press conference on Pilibhit Sadar's roll
events.organiser: Indian National Congress (Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee)
events.place: Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee headquarters, Lucknow
events.quote: Addressing a press conference at the Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee headquarters in Lucknow, AICC in-charge for UP Rajendra Pal Gautam alleged that the Election Commission had created a system through which "anyone can be defeated, and anyone can be made to win".
events.what: Congress leaders alleged that the names of 13,150 voters in Pilibhit Sadar were changed after the final roll while their EPIC numbers stayed the same, and asked for an inquiry.

events.title: 'Save democracy, end mob rule' campaign
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party, Haryana unit (Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini and state president Archana Gupta)
events.place: Across Haryana. Public meetings at district level and foot marches in assembly constituencies
events.quote: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Haryana will launch “save democracy, end mob rule” campaign from October 22 to November 5 to counter opposition political parties’ “repeated attempts” to question the credibility of constitutional institutions and undermine public confidence in the democratic system.
events.what: A 15-day BJP campaign in Haryana of press conferences, foot marches, district public meetings and constituency discussions presenting the party's case on the Election Commission and the SIR.

events.title: People's March to Reclaim Democracy
events.organiser: People Against SIR, an alliance of organisations formed on 14 October 2026
events.place: 58 gatherings in 13 states on the organisers' map, the New Delhi one at Gurudwara Bangla Sahib
events.quote: find the one nearest you and bring your friends along.
events.what: Marches and gatherings across the country on one day. The organisers' map lists 58 for 23 October, 23 of them in Karnataka and 9 in Rajasthan. Of those, 44 name a place, 49 give a time and 20 name a host. The New Delhi gathering is hosted by Voter Adhikar Manch and five other groups.

events.title: Human chain on Tank Bund
events.organiser: Telangana Voter Rights Forum (student and civil society organisations)
events.place: Tank Bund, along Hussain Sagar, Hyderabad
events.quote: Hundreds of people formed a human chain at Hyderabad’s Tank Bund along Hussain Sagar Lake on Saturday evening, demanding the scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the repeal of the CEC Act, 2023.
events.what: Hundreds of people formed a human chain against the revision. They asked for the revision to be scrapped, for the Chief Election Commissioner to be removed and for the CEC Act, 2023 to be repealed. The report says civil society, human rights, farmers', Dalit, youth and student organisations organised it together.

events.title: Protest at Dharna Chowk
events.organiser: MJP and Youth Welfare Telangana
events.place: Dharna Chowk, Indira Park, Hyderabad
events.quote: Dharna Chowk, Indira Park
events.what: A protest against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: Workers' March Against SIR in Govandi
events.organiser: Workers' March Against SIR
events.place: Samvidhan Chowk, Lallubhai Compound, Govandi, Mumbai
events.quote: Samvidhan Chowk, Lallubhai Compound, Govandi
events.what: A gathering against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: 'Loktantra bachao, bheedtantra hatao' campaign in Dakshina Kannada
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party, Dakshina Kannada unit (district president Satish Kumpala, committee led by Kishore Kumar Puttur, MLC)
events.place: Across Dakshina Kannada. Padayatras at district and Assembly constituency level, and sessions with youth and intellectuals
events.quote: District and Assembly constituency-level padayatras and interactive sessions with youth and intellectuals over SIR will be held as part of the campaign, he said.
events.what: A BJP campaign in Dakshina Kannada, part of the party's national campaign, which the district president said is aimed at public awareness of the revision, the accuracy of the voter lists and constitutional processes. The padayatras are to end by 5 November and the sessions with youth and intellectuals run to 30 November.

events.title: Gathering at Palakkad stadium bus stand
events.organiser: Collective for Democracy, Palakkad
events.place: Stadium Bus Stand, Palakkad
events.quote: Stadium Bus Stand
events.what: A gathering against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: March in Dhurpur
events.organiser: AIKMS, SKM
events.place: Dhurpur, Uttar Pradesh
events.quote: Dhurpur
events.what: A march against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: March to the Taluk Administrative Complex, H. D. Kote
events.place: From Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Bhavan to the Taluk Administrative Complex, H. D. Kote
events.quote: March from Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Bhavan to the Taluk Administrative Complex
events.what: A march against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: Jan Sunwai on a public audit of the roll in Trilokpuri
events.organiser: Jan Sarokar, Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan, NFIW and Voter Adhikar Manch, as The Indian Express reports
events.place: Trilokpuri Sabji Mandi, East Delhi
events.quote: The audit covered 1,236 voters across 700 households in four polling booths in Trilokpuri
events.what: A public hearing on a four-day door-to-door audit of booths 42, 43, 79 and 80, where the organisers say 416 of the 1,236 electors they verified had been wrongly listed as absent, shifted, dead or duplicate. Rahul Gandhi, Dipankar Bhattacharya, Yogendra Yadav and Prashant Bhushan attended, and The Indian Express describes volunteers helping a resident fill Form 6 there.

events.title: Gathering in Kakkanad
events.organiser: Students' and Youth Collective
events.place: Kakkanad, Ernakulam
events.quote: Kakkanad
events.what: A gathering against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: Protest at the Deputy Commissioner's Office, Yadgir
events.place: In front of the Deputy Commissioner's Office, Yadgir
events.quote: In front of the Deputy Commissioner's Office
events.what: A gathering against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: INDIA bloc march to the Chief Electoral Officer's office, Agartala
events.organiser: INDIA bloc, Tripura (CPI(M) state secretary Jitendra Chaudhury and Tripura Pradesh Congress president Ashish Kumar Saha)
events.place: From Orient Chowmuhani to the office of the Chief Electoral Officer, Tripura, Agartala
events.quote: प्रदर्शनकारी अगरतला के ओरिएंट चौमुहानी से सुबह 11 बजे मार्च शुरू कर त्रिपुरा के मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी (सीईओ) के कार्यालय पहुंचेंगे और वहां अपनी मांगों को लेकर ज्ञापन सौंपेंगे।
events.what: The INDIA bloc in Tripura announced a march against the revision ending with a memorandum at the Chief Electoral Officer's office. It demands that the revision be cancelled, that the Chief Election Commissioner be taken out of office and that the legal provisions on the Commission's independence be reviewed, and it opposes the provisions that give the Chief Election Commissioner legal protection.

events.title: Gathering at Shaheed Smarak Park, Agra
events.organiser: HSRA_2.0
events.place: Shaheed Smarak Park, Agra
events.quote: Shaheed Smarak Park
events.what: A gathering against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: INDIA bloc 'public impeachment' of the Chief Election Commissioner
events.organiser: INDIA bloc (announced by Congress general secretary K. C. Venugopal)
events.place: Hotel Ashok, New Delhi, as PTI reported it had learnt
events.quote: INDIA bloc will be holding a crucial Public Impeachment proceeding on 30th October
events.what: A mock Parliament of INDIA bloc MPs and leaders, at which Venugopal said the public's verdict to remove Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar would be delivered. It has no legal effect, since a Chief Election Commissioner can be removed only by Parliament in the manner of a Supreme Court judge. Venugopal said the Dilli Chalo March to Ramlila Maidan would follow on 1 November.

events.title: INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan
events.organiser: Indian National Congress, hosting INDIA bloc parties, with student bodies and civil society organisations
events.place: Ramlila Maidan, New Delhi
events.quote: The Delhi Police has issued a no-objection certificate (NOC) allowing the Congress to hold a one-day rally at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi on November 1, a senior police officer said on Saturday.
events.what: A one-day rally in Delhi organised by the Congress as part of the INDIA bloc's campaign against the SIR. Delhi Police issued a no-objection certificate. Congress general secretary K. C. Venugopal said on 24 October that a 'Dilli Chalo March' would end at Ramlila Maidan on 1 November, and Mahila Congress chief Alka Lamba said the rally would not be postponed or cancelled.

events.title: Meeting in Vijayawada
events.organiser: "Wake Up, Andhra Pradesh" Allied Organizations
events.place: Makineni Basavapunnaiah Vignana Kendram, near Raghavaiah Park, Vijayawada
events.quote: Makineni Basavapunnaiah Vignana Kendram (MBVK), near Raghavaiah Park
events.what: A gathering against the revision, listed on the People Against SIR map.

events.title: BJP padayatra in Hyderabad ('Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao')
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party, Telangana unit (state president N. Ramchander Rao)
events.place: Hyderabad (route not stated)
events.quote: Amit Shah ji will attend the padayatra on the 2nd (of November)
events.what: A BJP foot march in Hyderabad which the state party president said is to answer what he called the Congress's false narrative on the revision. He said Union Home Minister Amit Shah would take part.

events.title: INDIA bloc protest against SIR in Bengaluru
events.organiser: INDIA bloc Karnataka unit (KPCC president B.K. Hariprasad), with Congress, CPI, CPI(M), CPI(ML) Liberation, Samajwadi Party and Forward Bloc
events.place: Bengaluru (venue not stated)
events.quote: November 5 has been fixed for the Bengaluru protest.
events.what: A protest in Bengaluru announced by INDIA bloc parties in Karnataka, demanding the scrapping of the SIR and restoration of eligible voters' names. The parties said district and taluk demonstrations would follow.

events.title: BJP padayatra in Karnal with Amit Shah
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party, Haryana unit (state president Archana Gupta)
events.place: Karnal (the proposed venue the state president visited is in Sector 12)
events.quote: The BJP's campaign will also reach Karnal in Haryana on November 5, when Shah is scheduled to join a padyatra under the 'Save Democracy, End Anarchy' theme.
events.what: A BJP foot march in Karnal that Union Home Minister Amit Shah is to join, with Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini and Union Minister Manohar Lal expected. The state president said Shah would arrive at 10 am. It falls on the last day of the Haryana campaign in ev-26.

events.title: BJP march and public meeting on the SIR in Malappuram
events.organiser: Bharatiya Janata Party, Malappuram (State vice-president V. Unnikrishnan inaugurated the planning meeting)
events.place: Malappuram (route and venue not stated)
events.quote: The BJP will organise a march here on November 6 to counter what it calls misinformation about the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
events.what: A BJP march in Malappuram followed by a public meeting, which the party says is part of its nationwide campaign to explain the need for the revision.

events.title: Delhi Chalo marches and Constitution Day event
events.organiser: Indian National Congress (state units)
events.place: Six marches from Rajasthan, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh to Delhi
events.quote: The Congress will then take out six Delhi Chalo rallies from locations in Rajasthan, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh on November 25, culminating in an event in Delhi on Constitution Day, November 26.
events.what: The Congress announced six Delhi Chalo marches from Rajasthan, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh on 25 November, ending in an event in Delhi on Constitution Day, 26 November, as the last stage of its 'Vote bachao, Desh bachao' campaign.
